text_block_list.text:
One day, right when lunch is about to
end, I run
into Fuji Kiseki as she comes
out of the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
choice_data_list: Did you need something from the in...
Did you have business at the infir...

text_block_list.text:
A small blister pack of pills falls from
Fuji Kiseki's
pocket.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I have a little headache, so I just
stopped by for
some medicine. That's
all!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll be going now. Byyyeee!

Despite her best efforts to hide her
symptoms, it
seems Fuji Kiseki is
suffering from quite the
migraine...
